purpose: Operating threshold policy for the ADR-0004 holdout freeze, fixed before calibration runs.

approval.rule: If no threshold meets the budget, report it; never relax the budget.

seed_rule: Seed 1 is the first KAN-18 baseline seed. It is fixed here before calibration. Seeds 2 and 3 are reported for sensitivity only and can never become the operating policy, so a better-looking seed does not replace the declared one.
